_doc: How lupin matches marker-panel cell-type labels to Cell Ontology terms. Layered: this file, then ~/.config/lupin/cl_matching.json, then <run dir>/lupin/cl_matching.json; later files override the keys they set. See `lupin data where`.

synonyms._doc: synonym scope -> synonym types that count; [] = every synonym of that scope. OMO:0003000 marks abbreviations (HSC, CMP, GMP), OMO:0003004 plural forms.

classes._doc: Terms in these OBO subsets are the analysis classes panel types are grouped under.
classes._states: No class, whatever its subsets: states cells of many lineages pass through, which would group types across lineages.

plural._doc: Trailing word replacements, then a trailing 's' dropped from words of at least min_len letters (not 'ss').

implied._doc: Words a label may leave off its end: a label that matches no term is tried again with each appended (Immature_B -> immature B cell), taking the first that completes exactly one term's name (not a synonym).

marker_signs._doc: Marker signs: sign word -> the symbol that writes it. However a label writes one (X-positive, X positive, X+), it is compared as the one word x-positive.

_qualifiers: Words a term's name may have that a label leaves off: a label matching no name goes to the most general term whose name it is but for these words, when one is above all the others (MK1-positive CT1 cells -> MK1-positive, alpha-beta CT1 cell).
